bootstrap.resampling: One shared UID multiset per draw for every release and method, including idle selected users.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided percentile95, linear quantiles; no clipping or redrawing. Ratio draws with nonpositive reference gain are undefined and counted.

quality.estimand: Equal-release mean AUC gains. Preservation divides partial-minus-Reuse by full-current-code-minus-Reuse; Rebuild recovery uses a separate native first-request rebuilding denominator.
quality.scope: Selected user panel and fixed models; no training-seed replication or adjustment for exploratory selection. A positive point retention is not a noninferiority result.

acceptance.maintenance_scope: Exact fixed30k serving/maintenance FLOPs are evaluated separately; this quality merge does not establish the saving target.

memory.scope: Each user's peak retained state during sequential replay. Summed individual peaks are not simultaneously observed loaded-serving memory; frozen shared model/adapter weights and temporary scratch are excluded.

shared_charge_scope: Every independently launched run pays its own fold/static-item preparation. All fees remain in these executed counters; fixed30k cost with a declared replica count is a separate evidence artifact.
scope: NoCache/Static4k exact same encoder function; rawstrict is prior frozen .005 tolerance policy. Shared table IDs fit-only prerelease, cache size selected on cost. Existing benchmark is development mechanism verification, not new blind full-method confirmation.
